text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And thus, my first three years with Vodka come to a close.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But this doesn't mean our relationship ends here. There's still so much to work towards in the future.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: This is goodbye, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Come on, you know there's no helpin' it. Everyone's gotta say goodbye at some point.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm not the type to cling on forever. I know when to let go.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Our time runnin' together is over. It is what it is.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: It's what the passin' wind told me. On our long road through life, the people we encounter are but mere passersby.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: There's no end to our battle. Not beyond that mountain pass… Not beyond that sky…
choice_data_list: …Did you read that somewhere or something?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Me? R-read?! Hell no! My dad showed it to me from a manga he was readin'!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: In any case, thanks for everythin'. I'll be racin' on my own from now on.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Adios!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With a hammed-up farewell, Vodka runs off, leaving me somewhat dumbfounded.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Praying for her health and success, I contemplate what to do next as I return to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Aaagh, nope, nope, nope! I can't do it! Wait up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I turn to see a familiar face running to catch up with me.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: No matter how ya think about it, we can't do this! We can't leave each other!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: It's 'cause of you I've been able to run so cool in the first place!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Without you, I'd just go back to bein' lame!
choice_data_list: But you made such a cool exit…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry! I wasn't thinkin' straight! I just got carried away.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: You get it, right? Sometimes you're in the moment and ya just go too fa—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Augggh!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What I just said… It's exactly the kind of lame thing Dad always says when he's begging Mom to forgive him!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: This is the worst… Trainer, I guess I'm still lame after all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: No matter how cool she tries to act, I guess there are still some things that need refining.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hmph! No way we can part ways now! Ya can't leave me like this.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Ya gotta help me, partner. I need you in my sidecar forever!
